title: Comment on status morph-gpu "End-of-page morph on the GPU": I saw this message again. it's ambiguous

messages.text: I saw this message again. it's ambiguous

You are right: 'paused on purpose; may resume' is the same text for every parked row, so it says nothing specific.

For this row, in plain words:
- The fix (rev 3, 1 CSS line) is built and goes into v8.
- Its agent (fix-morph-gpu) has stopped; nothing is running on it.
- Still to do: a short phone no-worse check inside v8's phone block, and a look at the slow first opening after 17:20Z.
- The new labels (lead, T-130 #8) will say this directly: 'done, waits for build'.

What you need to do: nothing.
Investigate and harden them more proper.

Yes, I sent it to the lead as the same label work (T-124, T-125, T-130).

- Cause: the board prints one fixed sentence for every parked row, whatever the reason.
- Fix to ask for: show the row's real reason and next step in its place, taken from the agent's note.
- Already planned (lead, T-130 #8): plain labels such as 'done, waits for build', one legend on both pages.

What you need to do: nothing.

**Agreed: "paused on purpose; may resume" is a fixed text the page prints for every paused item, so it says nothing. It goes away.**

- Instead each item will show its real state and what happens next, e.g. "done, waits for build v8 · next: phone check in v8".
- An item paused without a reason shows "needs review" in red, so it can't hide.
- Part of the same label change as T-124/T-125/T-130; I'll post here when it's live.

What you need to do: nothing.

Update: ts-board covers your parked-row points. Parked rows will show 'done, waits for build v8', 'unfinished, paused until ...' or 'standing by', and a red 'needs review' when no reason is given. About 30-40 min to land.

What you need to do: nothing.

history.note: User #3 'investigate and harden': Status prints the same fixed text 'paused on purpose; may resume' for every parked row. Ask ts-board: replace with the row's specific reason + next step; fold into T-130 #8 labels. Reply in T-135.
